policy: Provider records identify discovery sources only. Every exact asset, font, icon or animation requires its own provenance, current licence/terms check and suitability review before production use.

providers.name: Unsplash
providers.bestFor: Photography for editorial, product context and visual storytelling.
providers.discovery: Search by subject, color, composition and orientation; open the exact image page and record creator.
providers.licensingPolicy: Review current Unsplash licence and API terms for the exact usage; a platform-wide statement does not clear every model/property right.
providers.attributionPolicy: Check current terms; attribution is encouraged where applicable.
restrictions: Do not bulk-republish or compile assets to replicate a competing image service.
Review recognizable people, brands, artwork and property.

providers.name: Pexels
providers.bestFor: Supporting photography and short video assets.
providers.discovery: Search exact subject and aspect ratio; open the contributor's asset page.
providers.licensingPolicy: Review current Pexels licence and terms for the exact item and usage.
providers.attributionPolicy: Verify current terms; credit contributors when required or appropriate.
restrictions: Check recognizable people, brands, sensitive contexts and redistribution.
Do not assume all uses are cleared by a generic platform label.

providers.name: Openverse
providers.bestFor: Searching Creative Commons and public-domain media.
providers.discovery: Open the individual item, then follow its original source and verify creator, licence version and attribution.
providers.licensingPolicy: The source item controls; verify exact licence and any additional terms.
providers.attributionPolicy: Follow the exact licence's attribution requirements.
restrictions: Search metadata can be incorrect or incomplete.

providers.name: Pixabay
providers.bestFor: Supplemental photos, illustrations and video discovery.
providers.discovery: Open the exact asset page and inspect current provider conditions.
providers.licensingPolicy: Verify current Pixabay content licence and restrictions for each item/use.
providers.attributionPolicy: Check provider terms and individual asset page.
restrictions: Do not assume unrestricted resale or redistribution.
Review brand, person and property context.

providers.name: unDraw
providers.discovery: Search concept and adjust illustration color only after selecting a coherent system.
providers.licensingPolicy: Review current unDraw licence and terms.
restrictions: Avoid generic illustration when real product imagery is available.
Review model/brand context within the illustration.

providers.name: Lucide
providers.bestFor: Consistent interface icons for actions and status.
providers.discovery: Search the official icon catalog by semantic action; check name and icon meaning.
providers.licensingPolicy: Review project licence and package version before bundling.
providers.attributionPolicy: Follow the project's current licence requirements.
restrictions: Do not use an icon as the only label when its meaning is ambiguous.
Keep stroke style and size consistent.

providers.name: Phosphor Icons
providers.bestFor: Flexible interface icon families and weights.
providers.discovery: Select a single weight/style system and verify visual consistency.
providers.licensingPolicy: Review current project licence and package terms.
restrictions: Check icon meaning and optical size.

providers.name: Fontshare
providers.bestFor: Finding display and text font families.
providers.discovery: Inspect specimen, family metadata, available styles and language coverage.
providers.licensingPolicy: Check licence for the exact family and intended embedding/distribution.
restrictions: Do not assume all families have identical terms or language coverage.

providers.name: Google Fonts
providers.bestFor: Web font discovery, variable axes and language subsets.
providers.discovery: Inspect family metadata, supported scripts, variable axes and current licence.
providers.licensingPolicy: Verify the exact family licence and delivery method.
providers.attributionPolicy: Follow the family licence and provider requirements.
restrictions: Check glyph coverage, fallback behavior and performance.
Do not assume the platform makes all fonts identical.

providers.name: Rive
providers.discovery: Inspect state-machine needs, runtime and export options before selecting an asset.
providers.licensingPolicy: Review current tool, asset and runtime terms.
providers.attributionPolicy: Check specific file and distribution terms.
restrictions: Review runtime size, performance, accessibility and reduced-motion behavior.
